title: Whatever This Class Paints Comes HOME 🖌️
description:
Whatever Kofi's art class paints shows up in town by Thursday. A bench turns up at the bus stop as bare pine with the pencil lines still on it, and then the color fills in. The one rule is about painting a person.

I've always wanted a big brother. So I joined the class and painted one.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment BROTHER if you'd have painted one too.
